bio.overview: John Petrucci is a founding member of Dream Theater and one of the most respected guitarists in progressive metal. Known for his technical prowess, precision, and compositional skills, Petrucci has been a driving force behind Dream Theater's sound since the band's inception.
extended_bio: Co-founded Dream Theater at Berklee College of Music in 1985 with John Myung and Mike Portnoy
11-time Grammy nominee and recipient of numerous 'Best Guitarist' awards from music publications
Designed signature Ernie Ball Music Man guitars used by musicians worldwide

studio: Ernie Ball Music Man JP Signature Series Guitars
live: Ernie Ball Music Man Majesty Guitars

trivia.did_you_know: Petrucci composed Dream Theater's 42-minute epic 'A Change of Seasons' in just three weeks.
